Class Scheduling

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.pixelpainter.service.Scheduling
public final class Scheduling extends Object
Schedules plugin work through the region-aware Paper schedulers.

The global, region and entity schedulers exist on Paper and on Folia. On Paper they all run on the single server thread, so the same code path serves both platforms. On Folia each task runs on the thread that owns the target location or player, which is the only thread allowed to read or change that state.

Use the global scheduler for plugin state that is not tied to a location, a region scheduler for block access and an entity hop for player-bound actions. Instances are stateless after construction and safe to share between threads.
